legality rules (a new dimension is a new @legality_rule):
  _rule_placement
  _rule_global_unique
  _rule_mutex
  _rule_lone_set_piece
  _rule_per_power_set_dup
hard-limit rules (a new limit is a new @hard_limit_rule):

  _rule_per_power_added_slots
  _rule_slot_after_power
  _rule_slot_on_grant_level
  _rule_slot_budget_over_time

  _rule_pick_at_grant_level
  _rule_pool_count
  _rule_prerequisites
  _rule_single_ancillary_pool
  _rule_mbd_powersets
  _rule_mbd_io_levels
  _rule_mbd_level_text
